wire.headline: Energy Firm Reports Revenue Rise Amid Job Cuts and Plant Closures
sentences: The company reported a 7% year-on-year increase in revenue, reaching 4.26bn GBP for the quarter ending on 30 September.
Pre-tax profit fell by 12% to 310m GBP during the same period.
The firm announced plans to cut 850 jobs, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants, one located in Wales and the other in Kent, will close by March 2027.
CEO Marian Holt stated that the cost pressure has been sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend was held steady at 12.4p a share.
